{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Texas Senate Bill 4 allows local law enforcement to check the immigration status of people in most instances, such as routine traffic stops.",

"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Arrests resulting from Texas Senate Bill 4 are characterized as illegal.",

"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Texas Senate Bill 4 allows law enforcement to detain Texas residents lacking legal status until Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrives to take them to privatized detention centers for processing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"All Texans will be endangered when fear of law enforcement and their continuous collaboration with ICE outweighs the need for help from those same government agencies when the victim of a crime.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The American Civil Liberties Union issued a travel advisory for those planning to visit Texas after September 1, 2017, due to restrictions on civil liberties brought by the bill.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
